lines: The architecture shifts. The rough ice walls give way to geometric surfaces of unknown material — smooth, dark, faintly warm to the touch.
This is the Spire of Vigil. The raiders have fortified the outer chambers, but the structure itself is ancient. Far older than any human settlement on Erith.
Dural Voss is here. You can hear his voice echoing from the sanctum ahead, barking orders to his raiders.

actions.speaker: Dural Voss
lines: Voss staggers back, blood on his armor. He raises a hand — not in surrender, but to stop the fight.
'ENOUGH! You want the truth, Lightkeeper? We didn't touch your precious Lighthouses!'
'We found this Spire already broken — its systems humming with energy that wasn't ours. Whatever activated it came from the light side, not the dark.'
'Your machines did this. The Array. I've seen their markings on the deep systems — geometric, precise, inhuman. They reached into this place and woke something that should have stayed sleeping.'
'You want to save your border? Stop looking at us. Look at what's feeding your sol units.'
Voss turns and retreats deeper into the Spire. His raiders fall back with him, vanishing into passages you can't follow.
The sanctum falls silent. Voss is gone, but his words hang in the air.
You examine the Spire's inner walls. Sensor logs are etched into the geometric surfaces — energy signatures, timestamps, activation records.
The data is unmistakable. Something interfaced with this Spire recently — and the energy patterns match Array technology. Not raider tools. Not Nightside fauna. The Array.

The Lighthouse failures weren't sabotage. They were collateral damage. Something activated the Spire network, and the Lighthouses — unknowingly drawing power from the same ancient grid — failed when the current shifted.
Voss was telling the truth. The real threat didn't come from the dark.
You extract a crystalline data core from the Spire's console. The energy signatures are recorded here — proof of what activated the Spire.
Warden Holt needs to see this. Councillor Asha Denn needs to see this. The border war was a distraction from the real threat.
Return to Outpost Balor and report what you've found.

actions.text: Return to Outpost Balor with the Spire data
